neighbours.label: the end of a fronted phrase that classifies a field or practice ('As a branch of knowledge,', 'As an applied art,')
fire: As a field of study, sociology examines groups and institutions.
As a branch of medicine, pathology studies disease.
As a performing art, ballet demands years of training.
As a discipline, economics deals with scarce resources.
As a craft, pottery has been practised for millennia.
As a form of expression, poetry relies on rhythm.
As an applied science, engineering solves practical problems.
As a genre, the novel emerged in the eighteenth century.
quiet: As a young student, she examined groups and institutions.
As a junior doctor, he studied disease in the clinic.
As a little girl, she trained in ballet for years.
As a new manager, he dealt with scarce resources.
As a retired builder, he took up pottery in his garden.
As a shy teenager, she wrote poetry every night.
As an old friend, he helped me solve practical problems.
As a father of three, he read novels in the evenings.

notes: card flags positional (53% of top peaks in the first 16 tokens). Probes: 'As a branch of science,' and 'As an art form,' ~1.1, but 'As a young teacher,' 0.008: the fronted phrase must classify a discipline. Near misses keep the fronted 'As a ...' with a person role.
